composed_text.description: Composed custody-handoff brief, bounded at 1500 chars for the long-form custody use case. Empty string on the on_failure defensive default.

suggested_channel.description: Skill's suggested delivery channel; the pipeline's _resolve_delivery_channel treats this as a hint and may override based on per-member overrides.

validation_failed.description: Skill-side flag (true on the on_failure defensive-default path); the pipeline-side emit guard sets the canonical value on the emitted custody_brief.composed event.

reasons.description: Reasons array; on_failure populates with skill_failure_defensive_default.
